      if (navigator.userAgent.match(/ipad/i)) return 'video_mweb';

      if (navigator.userAgent.match(/ipad/i)) return 'ios';

    const getRandom = () => {
      const min = 99999;
      const max = 1000000;
      return Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min)) + min;
    };

    let tcfConsentString = '';

    const getAdsTag = (pageUrl, section) => {
      let _partnerPublisherId = '';
      if (typeof window.Cookies !== 'undefined') {
        const ilg_mm_gam_cookie = window.Cookies.get('ilg_mm_gam');

          return taxonomy.primary_section.name || taxonomy.primary_section._id || '';

      }
      return '';

    const CMS_ID = "2722019";

    const randomString = (length) => {
      const chars = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789';
      let out = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < length; i += 1) out += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
      return out;
    };

    if (typeof window.Cookies !== 'undefined' && !window.Cookies.get('ilg_mm_gam')) {
      window.Cookies.set('ilg_mm_gam', JSON.stringify({ partnerPublisherId: randomString(36) }));
    }

    const getGAMDeviceIdentifier = () => {
      if (navigator.userAgent.match(/Mobile/i)) return 'video_mweb';
      if (navigator.userAgent.match(/iphone/i)) return 'video_mweb';
      if (navigator.userAgent.match(/ipad/i)) return 'video_mweb';
      return 'video_desktop';
    };

    const getGAMPlatformIdentifier = () => {
      if (navigator.userAgent.match(/Android/i)) return 'android';
      if (navigator.userAgent.match(/iphone/i)) return 'ios';
      if (navigator.userAgent.match(/ipad/i)) return 'ios';
      return 'browser';
    };

    const getRandom = () => {
      const min = 99999;
      const max = 1000000;
      return Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min)) + min;
    };

    let tcfConsentString = '';

    const getAdsTag = (pageUrl, section) => {
      let _partnerPublisherId = '';
      if (typeof window.Cookies !== 'undefined') {
        const ilg_mm_gam_cookie = window.Cookies.get('ilg_mm_gam');
        if (ilg_mm_gam_cookie) {
          _partnerPublisherId = JSON.parse(ilg_mm_gam_cookie).partnerPublisherId;
        }
      }
      const _url = 'https://pubads.g.doubleclick.net/gampad/ads?' +
        'env=vp' +
        '&gdfp_req=1' +
        '&output=xml_vmap1' +
        '&unviewed_position_start=1' +
        '&ad_rule=1' +
        '&wta=1' +
        '&plcmt=1' +
        '&vpa=auto' +
        '&vpos=preroll' +
        '&description_url=' + encodeURIComponent(pageUrl) +
        '&iu=/4758/partner_il_giornale/' + getGAMDeviceIdentifier() + '/' + getGAMPlatformIdentifier() + '/player' +
        '&vid=partnervideoid' +
        '&cmsid=' + CMS_ID +
        '&sz=640x480' +
        '&correlator=' + getRandom() +
        '&vpmute=0' +
        '&addtl_consent=' +
        '&gdpr_consent=' + encodeURIComponent(tcfConsentString) +
        '&gdpr=1' +
        '&ppid=' + _partnerPublisherId +
        '&cust_params=' +
        encodeURIComponent('pos=vod') +
        encodeURIComponent('&section=') + section +
        encodeURIComponent('&embed=0') +
        encodeURIComponent('&ptn_user_id=') +
        encodeURIComponent('&ptn_publisher_id=') + _partnerPublisherId +
        encodeURIComponent('&tad=0') +
        '&hl=it' +
        '&url=' + encodeURIComponent(pageUrl);
      return _url;
    };

    const getPageSection = (videoData) => {
      try {
        const taxonomy = videoData && videoData.taxonomy;
        if (taxonomy && taxonomy.primary_section) {
          return taxonomy.primary_section.name || taxonomy.primary_section._id || '';
        }
        if (taxonomy && Array.isArray(taxonomy.sections) && taxonomy.sections[0]) {
          return taxonomy.sections[0].name || taxonomy.sections[0]._id || '';
        }
      } catch (e) {
      }
      return '';
    };

    const resolveConsent = () =>
      new Promise((resolve) => {
        if (!window.__tcfapi) {
          resolve('');
          return;
        }
        window.__tcfapi('addEventListener', 2, (tcData, success) => {
          if (success && (tcData.eventStatus === 'useractioncomplete' || tcData.eventStatus === 'tcloaded')) {
            resolve(tcData.tcString || '');
          }
        });
      });

    window.PoWaSettings.advertising = window.PoWaSettings.advertising || {};
    // Fallback ad URL from Arc XP Video Center docs:
    // https://dev.arcxp.com/video-center/developer-docs/advertising-and-the-video-center-player/
    // https://pubads.g.doubleclick.net/gampad/ads?sz=640x480&iu=/124319096/external/single_ad_samples&ciu_szs=300x250&impl=s&gdfp_req=1&env=vp&output=vast&unviewed_position_start=1&cust_params=deployment%3Ddevsite%26sample_ct%3Dlinear&correlator='
    window.PoWaSettings.advertising.adTag = (opts = {}) => {
      [opts.videoData, opts.videoData && opts.videoData.additional_properties].forEach((obj) => {
        if (obj && obj.advertising) {
          obj.advertising.allowPrerollOnDomain = true;
          obj.advertising.playAds = true;
          obj.advertising.forceAd = true;
        }
      });

      return resolveConsent().then((consent) => {
        tcfConsentString = consent;
        return getAdsTag(window.location.href, getPageSection(opts.videoData));
      });
    };
  })();

Negli ultimi tempi, però, questo settore soffre a causa dell'aumento della complessità delle procedure e del costo dei trattamenti, che devono essere usati al di fuori della copertura del Servizio sanitario nazionale, rendendo questi studi spesso infattibili. Quello che chiediamo sono più risorse pubbliche.     };

    const getAdsTag = (pageUrl, section) => {

        const ilg_mm_gam_cookie = window.Cookies.get('ilg_mm_gam');

        if (taxonomy && taxonomy.primary_section) {
          return taxonomy.primary_section.name || taxonomy.primary_section._id || '';
        }
        if (taxonomy && Array.isArray(taxonomy.sections) && taxonomy.sections[0]) {
          return taxonomy.sections[0].name || taxonomy.sections[0]._id || '';
        }
      } catch (e) {
      }
      return '';
    };

    const resolveConsent = () =>
      new Promise((resolve) => {
        if (!window.__tcfapi) {
          resolve('');
          return;

    window.PoWaSettings.advertising.adTag = (opts = {}) => {

          obj.advertising.allowPrerollOnDomain = true;
          obj.advertising.playAds = true;
          obj.advertising.forceAd = true;
        }
      });

      return resolveConsent().then((consent) => {
        tcfConsentString = consent;
        return getAdsTag(window.location.href, getPageSection(opts.videoData));
      });
    };
  })();
